reviews.title: Greed takes over everything.
reviews.text: Thanks a lot for putting everything behind a paywall. And for making the free version of this app an ad ridden mess. You companies have lost your minds with this bs. I got this app a year ago and have paid for premium but now seeing this company sell out by putting AI generative tools and putting ads on every feature turned me away. I used to recommend this to friends looking into editing videos since, its free version was very accessible and had MANY features available to use, but I’ll be looking for something else.

reviews.title: Video Reverse Feature Not Working
reviews.text:
10/11/2026 리버싱 비디오 기능 갑자기 정상작동 안되고 있어요.
-
10/24/2026
The video reverse feature is still not working properly. There’s no progress bar or status indicator, so it’s impossible to tell whether the process is actually running or frozen. Even reversing a 1-second video clip takes over 20 minutes and remains stuck loading indefinitely.

I previously left a review about this issue and received an email asking me to contact support through the app. I’ve sent multiple in-app messages since then, but I haven’t received any response, and the issue still hasn’t been fixed.

It’s frustrating that such a basic feature doesn’t work and that repeated attempts to contact support have gone unanswered.

reviews.title: Paid features
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for almost 5 years to edit my social media content. I initially downloaded it because of the background removal and the masking tools. I genuinely feel that these are the two options that are on this app that have not been improved since they’ve been introduced. And now I fear with the introduction of AI. Any upgrades to this app will now be subscription features instead of a one time fee… I enjoy this app because it gave me something I felt like I owned. A community I felt like I was a part of. But it’s starting to feel like a cash grab. And less like an editing community.

reviews.title: Lacking customer service
reviews.text: I had a project to send out that I started working on in advance and when I came back to the project 97% of the special effects and edits stopped working. I emailed them twice and messaged them on Instagram because I have a deadline to meet. No response from the emails and then I got told to just basically wait till they respond through email. I paid for the yearly subscription and I want my money back.(The facts that you have to wait 3 business days to receive help with this company when you’re paying for this service is outrageous.)
